description: This Java class implements a provider for LwM2m models with versioning support, managing object models per tenant and handling dynamic retrieval and caching of models based on client registration.

classes.name: LwM2mVersionedModelProvider
classes.description: A provider class that manages versioned LwM2m object models per tenant, supporting dynamic loading and eviction of models.

classes.name: LwM2mVersionedModelProvider.DynamicModel
classes.description: Inner class implementing LwM2mModel, representing a dynamic, tenant-specific model that retrieves and caches object models based on client registration.

methods.name: getKeyIdVer
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for object ID and version, defaulting to a predefined version if none provided.

methods.name: getObjectModel
methods.description: Returns a new DynamicModel instance for a given registration.

methods.name: evict
methods.description: Removes cached models associated with a tenant or globally if tenant ID is null.

methods.name: getResourceModel
methods.description: Retrieves a resource model for a specific object and resource ID.

methods.name: getObjectModel
methods.description: Retrieves an object model for a given object ID, considering supported client versions.

methods.name: getObjectModels
methods.description: Returns all supported object models for a client.

methods.name: getObjectModelDynamic
methods.description: Fetches or loads an object model dynamically, with thread-safe caching.

methods.name: getObjectModel
methods.description: Loads an object model from external resource cache based on a key.
